channel.title: Pulse by Zerodha
channel.description: Latest financial and market news from all major Indian news sources aggregated in one place

item.title: Rupee closes at 95.21 vs USD, falls on-week as merchant, NDF-linked flows blunt dollar retreat
item.description: The Indian rupee experienced a slight uptick on Friday, yet ended the week on a weaker footing due to overwhelming dollar demand driven by various market activities. Despite a rise in positive sentiment linked to a projected balance of payments surplus and new foreign inflows, pressures from maturing non-deliverable forward positions and large-scale merchant payments hampered its progress.

item.title: ‘Don’t care’, says Donald Trump, chalking off alleged insider trading claims; $1.4 billion crypto windfall
item.description: Donald Trump rejected allegations of insider trading and profiting from the presidency, saying he does not manage his businesses. Defending his family's cryptocurrency ventures, he argued they are independently run and maintained that crypto and AI are strategic priorities for U.S. economic leadership.

item.title: Bitcoin climbs above $61,000 as weak US jobs data fuels Fed rate cut hopes
item.description: In the past 24 hours, Bitcoin was up 2.80% and Ethereum was up 6.24% to trade at $1,716 mark. Among the major altcoins, BNB, XRP, Solana, Tron, Hyperliquid, Dogecoin, and Cardano gained upto 6.68%.

item.title: IDFC First Bank Q1 update: Loan book grows 21% YoY to Rs 3.05 lakh crore; shares rise 2%
item.description: IDFC First Bank reported strong provisional Q1 FY27 business growth, with loans and advances rising 20.6% year-on-year and deposits increasing 18%. CASA deposits and the CASA ratio also improved, reflecting healthy balance sheet expansion. The stock gained nearly 2% following the business update, while the bank maintained steady lending momentum.

item.title: Malayalam, Telugu OTT Releases This Weekend: Muthassi, Veerabhadruni Rahasyam, Mollywood Times & More
item.description: Gurtukoshunnai, Hang Man and Top Telugu Influencer are some more titles releasing on OTT platforms for this weekend watch.

item.title: Pragyawan Technologies files DRHP with Sebi for Rs 400 crore IPO
item.description: Pragyawan Technologies has filed its DRHP with SEBI for an IPO comprising a Rs 400 crore fresh issue and an OFS of 15 million shares. The company will use fresh issue proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes, strengthening its diversified technology and infrastructure business.

item.title: 10 Phones To Buy Under 25,000 Amid Rising Handset Prices Due To Memory Chips
item.description: The best phones below Rs 25,000 are seldom complete all-rounders. Instead, manufacturers tend to prioritise a handful of strengths: whether that's performance, battery life or cameras, while trimming features in other areas to keep costs in check.

item.title: Nifty heading to 25,000, Bank Nifty to 60,000 soon; prefer private banks, NBFCs over PSU banks: CA Rudramurthy BV
item.description: Indian equity markets are showing strong upward momentum, breaking past key resistance levels. Analysts believe this rally has significant potential, with the Nifty eyeing 25,000. Supportive macro factors like stable crude prices, a steady rupee, and a slowdown in foreign investor selling are fueling optimism. The market favors private banks and NBFCs over PSU banks, with specific stock recommendations in pharma, IT, and platform businesses.

item.title: Stock Market Live: Nifty Above 24,200, Sensex Pares Some Gains As PSU Banks Drag
item.description: The NSE Nifty 50 rose as much as 0.8% to 24,378.15, while the BSE Sensex rose as much as 0.85% or 655 points to 78,127.52.

item.title: Can the ED attach a company’s assets after it enters insolvency? | Explained
item.description: The legal question before the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal was whether the protection available under the IBC moratorium extends to assets that are simultaneously the subject of proceedings under the PMLA

item.title: Kusumgar IPO price band fixed at Rs 398–419; Rs 650-crore issue opens July 8, GMP at 33%
item.description: Kusumgar has set its IPO price band at Rs 398–419 for a Rs 650-crore offer for sale, opening July 8. The issue has a grey market premium of about 33%, signalling strong demand. The company has reported steady revenue and profit growth, supported by a diversified industrial fabric portfolio.

item.title: Pune Bizman Murder: Siya Goyal Shows Middle Finger To Media On Camera, Video Goes Viral
item.description: Murder accused Siya Goyal made an obscene gesture at the media while being escorted by the police in the Ketan Agarwal case.

item.title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Breel Embolo And Dan Ndoye Goals Helps Sweitzerland Beat Algeria
item.description: Sweitzerland will now face the winner of the Colombia-Ghana clash in Vancouver in the Round of 16 fixture next week.

item.title: Is Westside The New Zudio? Bernstein Maps Trent's Expansion Sprint, Cuts Target By 30%
item.description: Bernstein cuts Trent's target to Rs 3,500 but keeps its Outperform call, arguing Westside's surprise 50-stores-a-year guidance deserves a fresh look after years of Zudio stealing the spotlight.

item.title: India’s services PMI drops to 17-month low of 57.4 in June 2026 as demand softens
item.description: The loss of momentum points to more challenging market conditions and weaker demand, particularly at home, says Pranjul Bhandari, Chief India Economist at HSBC

item.description: Half Man, Man of War, Daemons of the Shadow Realm and Sparks of Tomorrow are some more titles releases on OTT for this weekend watch.

item.title: 'Don’t care’, says Donald Trump, chalking off alleged insider trading claims; $1.4 billion crypto windfall
item.description: Donald Trump dismissed concerns over alleged insider trading and conflicts of interest after financial disclosures showed businesses linked to his family's cryptocurrency ventures generated an estimated $1.4 billion in 2025. Trump said he does not manage his businesses, calling the presidency a "much bigger purpose" than personal financial gains.

item.title: Banks See FCNR-B Deposit Mobilisation Gather Pace As RBI Scheme Gains Traction
item.description: Banks have mobilised an estimated $3-4 billion so far, with lenders expecting inflows to pick up from mid-July as awareness among overseas Indians increases.

item.title: Marico's best volume growth in quarters isn't luck; Abneesh Roy on what's really driving it
item.description: Marico is experiencing its strongest volume growth in quarters, signaling a genuine FMCG sector turnaround, not a statistical blip. Analyst Abneesh Roy anticipates this recovery to persist for at least two more quarters. Marico's raw material costs, particularly copra, have significantly decreased, positioning the company for a substantial margin improvement. This, coupled with aggressive advertising, makes Marico a standout performer.

item.title: 10 high-priced stocks rally up to 85% in CY26; here’s FII and MF exposure
item.description: Despite a weak broader market, several premium BSE stocks priced above Rs 5,000 delivered strong CY26 gains, led by Hitachi Energy India, Apar Industries and Solar Industries India.

item.title: Temasek-Backed Manipal Hospitals Gets SEBI Approval For IPO, Eyes July-End Listing | Profit Exclusive
item.description: Hospital chain plans to file an updated draft prospectus soon, with the proposed issue expected to be close to $1 billion, sources said.

item.title: Earnings growth to stay robust at 14–16%; IT correction a buying opportunity: Vikas Khemani
item.description: India's IT sector is poised for a comeback, with AI expected to boost, not hinder, growth. Vikas Khemani of Carnelian Asset Management sees excessive pessimism, presenting an attractive long-term opportunity. He highlights that historical tech shifts expanded the industry. Stock selection is crucial, favoring early AI adopters. Khemani also remains constructive on financials, power, and EV ancillaries, while cautious on value retail due to valuations.

item.title: Caught On Camera: LPG Tanker Explodes At Toll Booth In Uttar Pradesh, Four People Killed
item.description: Four people were killed and several others were injured in LPG tanker blast in the Kaushambi district of Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Tata Motors Partners With Welspun For 86 MW Wind-Solar Project To Power Four Plants
item.description: Tata Motors has partnered with Welspun Renewable Energy for an 86 MW wind-solar hybrid project that will supply green power to four manufacturing plants and cut over 1.4 lakh tonnes of CO2 emissions annually.

item.title: Citi sees Brent crude sliding to $60 as supply fears ease
item.description: Citi expects Brent crude to fall to $60 a barrel by year-end as shipping through the Strait of Hormuz normalises and supply concerns ease. The brokerage sees improving oil flows, while Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley also expect a supply surplus, signalling further downside risk for global crude prices.
